title: VanillaWars
description: This is the official modpack for the server, Vanilla Wars.
body:
**Welcome to Vanilla Wars – The Ultimate Modded PVP & Survival Experience!**


_Dive into a fully-loaded, adrenaline-fueled Minecraft world where survival meets strategy and chaos is just part of the fun. This isn’t your grandma’s vanilla server—this is modded mayhem like you’ve never seen before._

**⚔️ Guns, Glory, and PvP**

Arm yourself with an arsenal of firearms and gear up for intense PvP skirmishes. Whether you’re ambushing in the wild or defending your outpost, combat is brutal, fast-paced, and always personal.

**🏰 Base Building & Raiding**

Fortify your base with powerful tech and cunning traps—or go full offense and raid enemy strongholds for loot, resources, and dominance. Every build tells a story. Will yours be a fortress or a ruin?

**🧟 New Mobs, Machines, & Engineering Madness**

Face off against deadly new creatures while mastering high-tech machines, automation systems, and engineering marvels. Craft smarter, not harder.

**🌾 Farming, Fishing & Exploration**

Unleash your inner survivalist with tons of new crops, unique fish, and endless biomes to explore. Whether you’re building a peaceful farmstead or trekking into uncharted lands, there’s always something new to discover.

**🌐 Community-Driven Chaos**

Join a growing community of raiders, builders, engineers, and explorers. Forge alliances or make enemies—the choice is yours, but the world is unforgiving to the weak.

⸻

Ready to thrive or die trying? Log in now and claim your piece of the wasteland.

**IP: mc-vanillawars.com**
